method.boundary: Preloaded normalized FP32 RGB -> all four heads; fixed parameters installed outside timing; input conversion/staging and both submissions included in full-frame host timing.

modes.profile_disabled: Vector profiler image with counters disabled.
modes.coarse: Vector profiler image with coarse full-prefix brackets.

method.ordering: Four crops x six rounds, rotating and reversing four mode orders. Paired full frames run in original/vector_uninstrumented modes after a prefix-only sample, with image sealing outside timing.
method.verification: Prefix outputs 8/10 match scalar golden bytes in every prefix-only mode. Both prefix outputs and all four heads match scalar golden bytes in every paired full frame. Sampled and fully bracketed single-band outputs match selected scalar bands byte for byte.
method.limitations: Diagnostic Python/direct-dispatch host timing on CPU2; no camera or file IO. Coarse pooling/decimation baseline comes from the prior scalar profiling session on the same boot; prefix and complete-frame scalar/vector comparisons are paired in this run. Fine intervals are instrument-sensitive and not an additive partition.
